```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/particles.js@2.0.0/particles.min.js"></script>

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');

body { background: #eefbfe !important; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif !important; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif !important; color: #30384b !important; }

#particles-bg {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none;
}
#particles-bg canvas {
  position: absolute !important; inset: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important;
}

/* ── Timeline ── */
.timeline {
  position: relative; max-width: 780px;
  margin: 0 auto; padding: 0.5rem 1rem 2rem 1rem;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.timeline::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; left: 85px; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #92a7f2 6%, #92a7f2 94%, transparent);
}
.tl-item {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 60px 24px 1fr;
  gap: 0 16px; align-items: start; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; cursor: pointer;
}
.tl-year {
  font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #92a7f2;
  text-align: right; padding-top: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.tl-dot {
  width: 13px; height: 13px; background: #fff;
  border: 2.5px solid #92a7f2; border-radius: 50%;
  margin-top: 15px; justify-self: center;
  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.tl-item:hover .tl-dot, .tl-item.open .tl-dot {
  background: #92a7f2; transform: scale(1.2);
}
.tl-card {
  background: #fff; border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
  border: 1px solid rgba(146,167,242,0.2); overflow: hidden;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.tl-item:hover .tl-card { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.11); }
.tl-card-top { padding: 0.8rem 1.1rem; }
.tl-name { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; margin: 0 0 0.15rem 0; line-height: 1.3; }
.tl-org { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #888; margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0; }
.tl-hint { font-size: 0.7rem; color: #999; margin: 0; }
.tl-body {
  display: none; padding: 0 1.1rem 1rem 1.1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(146,167,242,0.15);
  animation: fadeSlide 0.3s ease;
}
.tl-item.open .tl-body { display: block; }
.tl-body p, .tl-body li { font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #444; margin: 0.7rem 0 0 0; text-align: justify; }
.tl-body ul { margin: 0.7rem 0 0 0; padding-left: 1.2rem; }
.tl-body li { margin: 0.3rem 0; }

/* ── Skills ── */
.skills-box {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
  margin: 0 auto 1.5rem auto; max-width: 780px;
}
.skills-box h3 { color: #92a7f2 !important; font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; margin-top: 0; }
.lang-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.7rem; }
.lang-name { width: 110px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #333; flex-shrink: 0; }
.lang-bar-bg { flex: 1; height: 7px; background: #e0e0e0; border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; }
.lang-bar { height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; background: #92a7f2; }
.lang-level { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #999; width: 70px; text-align: right; flex-shrink: 0; }
.skills-divider { border: none; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; margin: 1.2rem 0; }

/* ── SVG Hexagons ── */
.hex-svg-wrap { margin-top: 0.5rem; width: 100%; }
.thread { stroke: #b2c5fc; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: none; }
.thread-anim { stroke-dasharray: 5 9; animation: flowThread 2s linear infinite; }
@keyframes flowThread { from { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } to { stroke-dashoffset: -28; } }
.hex-poly { stroke-width: 1.5; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.18s; }
.hex-poly:hover { opacity: 0.78; }
.hex-dv { fill: #dce8fb; stroke: #94b8e8; }
.hex-st { fill: #e8d6f5; stroke: #b898d8; }
.hex-ds { fill: #d4f0e8; stroke: #74c8a8; }
.hex-txt {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
  fill: #444; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: middle; pointer-events: none;
}

/* ── Women box ── */
.women-box {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
  max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 1.5rem auto;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
}
.women-box h6 { color: #30384b !important; font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif !important; }
.textopeque { font-size: 0.82rem; color: #777; display: block; line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; }
.link-link {
  color: #92a7f2 !important; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.link-link:hover { opacity: 0.75; }

@keyframes fadeSlide { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-5px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .timeline::before { left: 52px; }
  .tl-item { grid-template-columns: 44px 20px 1fr; gap: 0 10px; }
  .tl-year { font-size: 0.65rem; }
}
</style>
```

```{=html}
<script>
function toggleItem(item) {
  item.classList.toggle('open');
  const hint = item.querySelector('.tl-hint');
  hint.textContent = item.classList.contains('open') ? '▲ close' : '▼ read more';
}

const svgTips = {
  python:  "Python · Primary tool throughout my career. Maps, charts, data analysis, statistics.",
  tableau: "Tableau · Personal data visualisation projects.",
  dw:      "Datawrapper · Personal data visualisation projects.",
  d3:      "D3.js · Interactive dashboards for seasonal forecast communication.",
  canva:   "Canva · CV design, slide decks and presentation materials.",
  html:    "HTML & CSS · This very website.",
  ai:      "Adobe Illustrator · Climate art posters.",
  baz:     "Bazaart · Collages and visual posts."
};
let svgActive = null;
function svgTip(id) {
  const bg  = document.getElementById('stip-bg');
  const txt = document.getElementById('stip-txt');
  if (svgActive === id) {
    bg.setAttribute('opacity','0'); txt.setAttribute('opacity','0');
    svgActive = null; return;
  }
  svgActive = id;
  txt.textContent = svgTips[id];
  bg.setAttribute('opacity','1'); txt.setAttribute('opacity','1');
}

window.addEventListener('load', function() {
  particlesJS('particles-bg', {
    particles: {
      number: { value: 60, density: { enable: true, value_area: 900 } },
      color: { value: '#92a7f2' },
      shape: { type: 'circle' },
      opacity: { value: 0.35, random: true },
      size: { value: 3, random: true },
      line_linked: { enable: true, distance: 150, color: '#92a7f2', opacity: 0.2, width: 1 },
      move: { enable: true, speed: 1.2, direction: 'none', random: true, out_mode: 'out' }
    },
    interactivity: {
      detect_on: 'canvas',

    retina_detect: true
  });
});
```
